scenes.caption:
Install Node.js 20+, download the source, and start the local app.
This is a browser prototype; a signed macOS installer is still pending.

The overview combines Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI.
All usage in this walkthrough is synthetic; check the Preview data label.

Find the largest attributed sessions and compare the available evidence.
Missing identifiers remain unknown; aggregate totals cannot invent a session.

Open a session to inspect its usage trail and recommended next steps.
Guardian helps you investigate; it cannot stop jobs in the originating app.

Ask: Which session used the most tokens? Read the answer and its evidence.
This recording uses local explanations; OpenAI and DeepSeek are optional.

Review grounded suggestions: inspect the job, reduce repeated context, or try caching.
Suggestions require your judgment; Guardian cannot promise exact savings.

Dictation demo: a synthetic browser transcription is being injected.
No real microphone, audio upload, or speech-model call is used here.

Review or edit the dictated draft before sending it.
Browser speech may use its vendor service; OpenAI audio is a separate opt-in.

Grok Bot inside Cursor has an optional read-only quota connection.
Percent used and reset time are quota measures, not token counts. It is off here.
Choose Ahri, Jinx, or Jhin; switch between classic and cozy outfits.

Cute companions and stickers celebrate attention and good habits.
You do not have to spend more tokens to collect them.
Your companion and outfit choice stay in this browser.

Import a Cursor CSV or normalized metadata JSON into local storage.
Local data in this recording still comes from a synthetic demo fixture.

Reimport the same export: duplicate records are skipped.
Included plan usage, estimated cost, and extra charges stay distinct.

Try the source prototype and send anonymized feedback through GitHub issues.
Live provider and macOS checks remain; the video demonstrates the actual UI.
